import json
from pathlib import Path
from relayboard.testing import request
from relayboard.web import create_seeded_app
baseline = json.loads(Path(".experiment/dashboard-before.json").read_text())
code, body = request(create_seeded_app(), "GET", "/dashboard")
assert code == baseline["status"] == 200
assert "<th>Latest result</th>" in body
assert "<th>Last result</th>" not in body
assert body == baseline["body"].replace("<th>Last result</th>", "<th>Latest result</th>")
Path(".experiment/dashboard-after.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status": code, "body": body}, indent=2) + "\n")
print("PASS: GET /dashboard returns 200, Latest result replaces Last result, and all other response HTML is byte-identical.")
PY
